name: WLM (Hubble)
blurb: WLM, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: namewlmgalaxy-hubble
story: The Wolf-Lundmark-Melotte galaxy is a small dwarf galaxy, about 3 million light-years away, that has lived in isolation. Hubble looked deep enough here to reach its oldest stars and read the story of how it built up its stars over time.

claims.text: WLM is the dwarf galaxy Wolf-Lundmark-Melotte
WLM is a barred, irregular, dwarf galaxy about 3 million light-years away
WLM is also cataloged as DDO 221
WLM is an isolated dwarf galaxy close enough for Hubble to reach its oldest main-sequence turnoffs; the program measures its star formation history
